title: Projection outbox core
description: Objective: add normalized domain projections, upcasters, atomic outbox/inbox receipts, and resumable cursor reads over the existing SQLite foundation. Deliverable: focused store modules for projections, relay state, and subscriptions. NOT in scope: network transport, external effects, UI, or business reducer logic. Hard dependency: Runtime contract registry. Owned paths: packages/store/src/projections/**, packages/store/src/outbox-relay/**, and packages/store/src/subscriptions/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/store typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/store test.
definitionOfDone: Event, projection, and outbox rows commit atomically and duplicate delivery deduplicates by durable inbox receipt.
Projection rebuild equals the live canonical projection for generated histories.
Unknown versions, poison events, missing cursors, and generation mismatch yield typed hold or CURSOR_GAP without silent skip.
The focused store typecheck and test command exits 0.
taskRails: Follow the pinned design; this task cannot create authority beyond its named contract.
Fail closed with stable codes and immutable deterministic outputs.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400.
Use TDD and stage only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, or merge.
